content.user_title: Analyze Quant Strategies and Portfolio Risk
content.value_statement: Quant finance work needs disciplined modeling, realistic backtests, and risk-aware evaluation. This skill structures research with metrics, validation steps, and portfolio analysis guidance.
actual_capabilities: Guides trading strategy development and backtesting with transaction costs and slippage.
Defines risk metrics such as VaR, Sharpe ratio, and maximum drawdown.
Supports portfolio optimization methods, including Markowitz and Black-Litterman approaches.
Covers time series forecasting, options pricing, Greeks, and statistical arbitrage.
Produces risk reports, return visualizations, and parameter sensitivity analysis.
Recommends pandas, numpy, and scipy for vectorized quantitative workflows.
limitations: Does not provide live market data or broker execution.
Requires clean historical data and explicit assumptions from the user.
Financial outputs are analytical support, not investment advice.
Backtest quality depends on realistic costs, slippage, and out-of-sample validation.

use_cases.title: Backtest a Trading Idea
use_cases.description: Turn a signal concept into a tested strategy with costs, slippage, and risk-adjusted performance metrics.

use_cases.title: Review Portfolio Risk
use_cases.description: Evaluate exposures, drawdowns, VaR, and diversification before changing allocation weights.

use_cases.title: Model Derivatives and Time Series
use_cases.description: Analyze pricing assumptions, Greeks, forecasting methods, and parameter sensitivity for financial instruments.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Simple Backtest
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a basic backtest for this trading signal. Include required data, assumptions, metrics, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Strategy Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this strategy result for Sharpe ratio, maximum drawdown, VaR, exposure concentration, transaction costs, and overfitting risk.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a portfolio optimization plan using these assets, constraints, return assumptions, risk model, and rebalancing rules.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Research for Production
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this quant research workflow for data leakage, out-of-sample design, market microstructure assumptions, and production readiness.

output_examples.input: Assess a moving-average crossover strategy on daily equities.
output: Backtest plan with training, validation, and out-of-sample periods.
Performance review using Sharpe ratio, drawdown, turnover, and cost assumptions.
Risk notes covering parameter sensitivity, regime changes, and data quality.

output_examples.input: Compare two portfolio allocations for a long-only mandate.
output: Allocation comparison by expected return, volatility, drawdown, and concentration.
Optimization guidance for constraints, diversification, and rebalancing cadence.
Clear caveats about assumptions, sample period limits, and stress testing.

best_practices: State data sources, date ranges, costs, slippage, and benchmark assumptions before analysis.
Separate research, validation, and production logic to reduce leakage and overfitting.
Report both absolute and risk-adjusted results with sensitivity checks.
anti_patterns: Do not judge a strategy by return alone without drawdown and cost analysis.
Do not tune parameters on the test period or ignore out-of-sample performance.
Do not treat generated analysis as financial advice or guaranteed performance.

faq.question: What finance tasks does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports backtesting, risk metrics, portfolio optimization, time series analysis, options pricing, and statistical arbitrage workflows.

faq.question: Can it fetch live market data?
faq.answer: No. It can guide data requirements and analysis, but the user must provide or connect market data sources.

faq.question: Does it make investment recommendations?
faq.answer: No. It provides analytical structure and risk review, not personalized investment, legal, or tax advice.

faq.question: Which tools and libraries does it reference?
faq.answer: The skill recommends pandas, numpy, and scipy for vectorized quantitative analysis.

faq.question: How should I prepare input data?
faq.answer: Provide clean price, return, volume, benchmark, and cost data with clear date ranges and assumptions.

faq.question: Can it help audit a backtest?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review transaction costs, slippage, data leakage, out-of-sample design, and risk-adjusted metrics.
